verdicts.quote: Schedule is relative to the invoice due date; default offsets in days are `-3, 0, 7, 14`.
`paid`, `draft`, `void` (ignored) … Partially paid invoices are eligible and are reminded for the outstanding amount only.
verdicts.missing: The eligibility rule omits how a credit note, dispute or payment plan affects an otherwise eligible invoice.

verdicts.quote: INV-1002 (total 800.00, paid 300.00) is eligible and its email states outstanding `500.00 USD`, not 800.00.
customers flagged do-not-contact … Out of scope domain rules: delivery receipts, opt-out, language.
verdicts.missing: No rule says how customer pauses, do-not-contact flags or unsubscribes affect sending, or whether billing notices may still be sent after a marketing opt-out.

verdicts.quote: A consumed milestone is never sent again (T-7). … After a crash with an unknown outcome the attempt counts as failed and is retried (at-least-once, PD-6)
verdicts.missing: The spec permits a second email if the provider accepted the first before the process crashed. It supplies no way to deduplicate that retry.

verdicts.quote: Immediately before each send it re-reads that one invoice from the invoice source and sends only if it is still eligible with the freshly read outstanding amount
One attempt per milestone per run; the next run that finds the milestone still due tries again. After 3 attempts (PD-7) without success the milestone is Exhausted (T-4) and is never retried
verdicts.missing: Sender failures consume retries during an outage. Exhaustion is visible in history, but the spec excludes an alert and assigns nobody to receive an escalation.

verdicts.quote: the email provider's rate limit are unknown … Until set, the product processes invoices sequentially and makes no capacity claim
verdicts.missing: Sequential sends have no specified pacing against a provider quota or throttling response.

verdicts.quote: A run on an installation with a long-overdue invoice sends its latest due milestone once … the first real run on a system with overdue invoices will send reminders to every one of them
verdicts.missing: Older steps are suppressed per invoice, but there is no rollout rule to spread the first sends across the backlog of overdue invoices.

verdicts.quote: as-of = today in the configured timezone … Offsets and dates use calendar dates only; no time of day is configured
verdicts.missing: The spec gives one configured timezone. It gives no customer-local send window or rule for business hours, weekends or holidays.

verdicts.quote: outstanding amount as `<amount with two decimals> <currency>` … `500.00 USD`
Missing contact: skip `no-recipient`. Invalid contact: skip `invalid-recipient` … Out of scope: delivery and bounce tracking
verdicts.missing: There is no action for an address that passes validation and then bounces after provider acceptance.

verdicts.quote: to the invoice's `contact_email`. A valid contact is exactly one address … `a@x.example,b@y.example` invalid

recorded time (UTC, ISO 8601), as-of date, invoice id, offset, outcome (`sent`, `failed`, `exhausted`, `superseded`, `skipped`), reason or attempt count, and for sent or failed entries the recipient address.
verdicts.missing: History can be filtered by invoice in the CLI. The spec provides no history on the invoice itself and retains no copy of the sent message.

verdicts.quote: invoice number; due date as `YYYY-MM-DD`; outstanding amount as `<amount with two decimals> <currency>`; the payment URL line only when `payment_url` exists
verdicts.missing: The spec gives no expiry rule for the payment link or alternative way to pay when the URL is absent.

verdicts.quote: The owner configures: `enabled` … `offsets_days` (default `[-3, 0, 7, 14]`) … manual `run` is the same command
verdicts.missing: The owner configures the schedule, but the spec assigns no authority to send or stop an individual reminder by hand.

verdicts.quote: `enabled = false` makes `run` exit 0, print `reminders disabled`, send nothing and leave the ledger unchanged … `invoice-reminders run --dry-run` evaluates exactly as a real run
verdicts.missing: There is no customer-specific disable control or manual resend action for a previously sent reminder.

verdicts.quote: `run --dry-run` reads the same sources and prints what a real run would send, changing nothing. … operator runs `history` to see what was sent, skipped or failed.
At most one reminder is sent per invoice per run … A run on an installation with a long-overdue invoice sends its latest due milestone once
verdicts.missing: The limit applies separately to each invoice. There is no cap on total sends in a run or time window and no maximum age for the latest due reminder.

verdicts.quote: The product never modifies invoices; invoices belong to an external invoice source.
